hook_text: 3 times the bracket 2x minus 5. If you wrote 6x minus 5, the second bag got robbed. Here is the fix.
clip_script: A bracket is a row of bags, one per term. The number in front is a delivery, and it goes to EVERY bag. 3 times 2x minus 5: three lots of 2x is 6x, three lots of negative 5 is negative 15. 6x minus 15. A letter in front works the same: 2x times 3x squared minus x plus 4 — numbers times, little numbers add — 6x cubed minus 2x squared plus 8x. A negative delivery flips every sign it touches: negative 2 times negative 3x is PLUS 6x. And dividing shares too: 12x cubed minus 8x squared plus 4x, all over 4x, is 3x squared minus 2x plus 1 — that last 1 is a term divided by itself, and it is not nothing. Check by plugging in 1, or multiply back.
visual_style: A row of three paper bags beneath a bracket; a glowing 3 hops into each in turn and the contents triple; a red negative delivery flips signs as it lands; a division bar slides under the row and each bag shrinks.
mood: Energetic, clear, a touch of comedy.
pacing: Quick hops between bags, a dramatic sign flip, a calm check at the end.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and distribute without leaving a term behind.
